original.statement: Istio's default retry policy no longer retries on 503; setting EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY to false reverts this, and the flag will be removed in future releases.

decision.reason: [ev-28c263f19767] says the default retry policy no longer retries on 503 responses. The configuration stays the same but the runtime retry behaviour is different, so behavior-changed is the right change type. The subject name "default-retry-policy-503" is a short kebab-case name made only from the evidence's own key words. The EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY flag is a backward-compatibility way to undo the change, not the change itself.
